name: satellite-vision-toolkit
description: Detect remote-sensing objects and segment land cover in satellite and aerial imagery.

interface.shortDescription: Detect objects and map land cover in overhead imagery.
interface.longDescription: Analyze satellite and aerial images with a remote-sensing object detector and an OpenEarthMap land-cover segmentation model, then export visual, tabular, and pixel-coordinate results.
defaultPrompt: Detect objects in this satellite image.
Segment land cover and summarize the area share.
Explain the limits of these remote-sensing results.
